{{Quote|No Wookiees!|Advertisement for the Abafar Junior Dejarik Club|<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
The '''Abafar Junior Dejarik Club''' was a social gathering on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], in which young people would meet periodically to play [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. It was located near the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were not allowed to participate,<ref name="Missing in Action" /> probably due to the fact that they were known to pull people's arms out of their sockets when they lost.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
